lines.zh: 缓慢爬行，腐肉在风中摇曳。
lines.en: Crawling slowly, flesh sways in the wind.
Decaying skin rubs against the ground.

lines.zh: 腐烂的指甲抓向你的脸。
lines.en: Decaying nails claw at your face.
Decaying flesh emits a nauseating stench.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤在关节处破裂。
lines.en: Decaying skin cracks at the joints.

lines.zh: 腐烂的血液沿着地面流淌。
lines.en: Decaying blood trickles on the ground.
I close the distance half a step at a time.
My dragging hand still grabs at the ground.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤垂挂在骨骼上。
lines.en: Decaying skin hangs from the bones.

lines.zh: 我站着，肩上的皮往下滑。
lines.en: I stand, and the skin on my shoulder slides down.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤在风中摆动。
lines.en: Decaying skin swings in the wind.
Flesh sways in the gentle breeze.

lines.zh: 腐肉在微风中轻轻摆动。
lines.en: Flesh gently swings in the breeze.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤在微风中摆动。
lines.en: Decaying skin swings in the breeze.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的肋骨，带出哨音。
lines.en: Wind passes through my ribs and whistles.

lines.zh: 眼皮烂光了，只剩两只眼。
lines.en: My lids rotted away. Only eyes stay.
Slowly turns to look for you.

lines.zh: 盯着你，寻找可以咬的目标。
lines.en: Stares at you, looking for a bite target.
Turns to you, searching for weakness.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，口水挂在下巴上。
lines.en: My head tilts, drool hanging from my chin.

lines.zh: 凝视你，寻找可以咬的地方。
lines.en: Gazes at you, searching for a bite spot.
Seeks you out, preparing to attack.
Your calf is easier to bite than your neck.

lines.zh: 骨头断了，我爬也要爬过去。
lines.en: My bone snapped; I will crawl there anyway.

lines.zh: 我被压在梁下，还伸着手。
lines.en: I'm pinned under a beam and still reaching.
My jaw has fallen off; I'm still hungry.

lines.zh: 救我，我的下巴已经掉了。
lines.en: Help me; my jaw has already come loose.
The flesh is gone, but the bones still walk.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指伸向你，快点远离！
lines.en: 腐烂的手指伸向你, move away!

lines.zh: 我的肚子好饿，快给我食物！

lines.en: I need your flesh, taste it!

lines.zh: 你把肉扔过来，我扑了个空。
lines.en: You toss the meat and I lunge short.

lines.zh: 我闻到了你的恐惧，哈哈！
lines.en: I smell your fear, ha ha!
You hit me, now you’re next!
Don’t touch me, I’ll bite you!
My hand hit you, don’t move!
The smell of blood is behind this wall.

lines.zh: 墙后有人在喘，我听得见。
lines.en: Someone is breathing behind the wall; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我捡起一只断掉的鞋带。
lines.en: I pick up a snapped bootlace.
A living one! Right under that tree!
Footsteps at the end of the corridor.
From the rubble, I smell you.
Even empty sockets can see you.
I turn my body toward you.
I do not shout. I only walk.

lines.zh: 你退向楼梯，那里没有窗。
lines.en: You back toward the stairs; there's no window there.
I will feast on your flesh!
This door only lets one through.
Cut me and I still come closer.
I will not give up a step.
There is dirt under every nail.
This mouth only ever learned to bite.
You will not live to see me tire.
The turning starts at the wound.

lines.zh: 咬下去，你就再也治不好了。
lines.en: One bite, and you will never heal.
One more bite, I have not had enough.

lines.zh: 我咬开你的袖口，血是甜的。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve open; the blood is sweet.

lines.zh: 咬下去，牙齿断了也不松。
lines.en: I bite down, and broken teeth do not let go.
I catch your wrist and bite.
You have a hole in you now.
This bite lands harder than the last.
You will go cold too, slowly.

lines.zh: 我从烧毁的车厢里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from a burnt-out car.
One turn of the soil and I rise.

lines.zh: 二十六号这只刚站起来。

lines.en: This husk wears a new face.

lines.zh: 我从翻倒的车底下爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from under the overturned car.
Even burning, I feel no pain.
My leg snapped. I crawl instead.
Water fills my lungs, and I do not struggle.
Half blown apart, and still moving.
An arrow sticks in me like a splinter.
Starved to bone, and still searching.
Lightning struck, and half of me is charred.
Cast into the void, I keep falling.
